WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) AS total_runs,
        COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) AS total_extras
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(wt.ball_id) AS total_wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON b.match_id = wt.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = wt.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = wt.ball_id
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT 
    br.bowler,
    br.total_runs + br.total_extras AS total_runs_conceded,
    bw.total_wickets,
    CASE 
        WHEN bw.total_wickets = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE (br.total_runs + br.total_extras) * 1.0 / bw.total_wickets 
    END AS bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 20
